summary: Civeo Corp filed an 8-K reporting entry into an amended and restated revolving credit facility on April 23, 2026. The amendment extends the maturity to April 23, 2030, increases commitments by $20 million to a total of $285 million, and adjusts interest rate margins. The facility comprises tranches for the company, its U.S. and Australian subsidiaries, and includes standard leverage covenants and restrictions. This is a routine refinancing/upsizing of existing credit lines, not a special situation event.
